create_gemini_file_search_store: create a Gemini File Search store with a display name using the File Search API
upload_file_to_gemini_store: upload a file to a Gemini File Search store using resumable upload with chunking config
ingest_file_gemini_rag: ingest a file into Gemini RAG by creating a store and uploading the file for search
initiate_resumable_upload_gemini: initiate a resumable upload session for a Gemini File Search store with file metadata
upload_gemini_file_content: upload file content to a Gemini resumable upload URL and finalize the session
